title: My Mallworld
content: I know I've been dreaming every night except lately I can hardly remember them when I wake up. One thing I do know is I wake up exhausted like I didn't even sleep. But last night I had a dream about my uncle who passed away a few months ago. He didn't say anything to me but he gave me his famous "it is what it is" shrug. I can still feel his presence. When I told my family earlier my aunts were amazed because towards the end of his battle with cancer he gave that shrug more often so for him to do that in my dream is just crazy
